0022600026.text: The Celtics (6-2) are on the road at Charlotte (3-6) for their ninth game of the season in the Emirates NBA Cup's East Group C, with Boston holding a 5-0 home record, a 1-2 road mark, and a 6-2 record over its last ten games. Charlotte is on a five-game losing streak, is 2-3 at home, and sits 3rd in the Southeast, 2 games back, and it is missing Grant Williams (out, hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (out, leg soreness). Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness) and Jayson Tatum (out, rest), while Payton Pritchard is day-to-day with an eye abrasion and is a game-time decision; the teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7.
